stores.notes: Primary Manifest V3 package for Chrome Web Store review. Uses minimal scoped permissions (activeTab, scripting, storage, tabCapture, offscreen, YouTube, Instagram, X/Twitter) and optional permissions for local Ollama/LM Studio and BYOK providers.
Published and live on Microsoft Edge Add-ons (v2.1.0 adds X/Twitter + Study Revision Notes mode + live Groq/OpenRouter probing). Zero native host or companion binary required.
